name: B N
summary:
AI Product Manager owning LLM output quality for a production tax-research and filing platform, where a wrong citation or
a wrong line on a return is a compliance risk rather than a UX bug. Built the full quality loop behind the product: a
self-maintaining 270K+-record primary-law corpus, human-expert golden datasets (Keystone benchmark; Project Evals - tax
analysts authoring 2,000 reviewed datasets), & the evaluation layer that turns both into shipped fixes. Also built
CrossSource, an open-source legal-RAG eval harness. Previously shipped a $2.7M MRR enterprise product.
experience:
Product Manager, Instead Sept 2025 – Present
AI-native tax research, planning & filing platform; first new entrant in 20 years to clear IRS e-file approval alongside the incumbents -
2,540 federal, state, and local forms supported
Own end-to-end output quality for production tax-research LLM, where wrong citations are a compliance risk: built the
evaluation layer that makes quality measurable - flag classify-by-failure-mode weekly-review citation loop &
4-dimension rubric (answerability, accuracy, citation quality, actionability) scored via LLM-as-judge with human validation
- so regressions are caught before release, not by clients. Holds ~95% citation accuracy on the golden eval set.
Grounded the model roadmap in evidence, not opinion: structured comparative experiments against three competing
tax-AI research platforms (50+ scenarios, 5 rounds) and a "pipeline-collapse" eval testing whether the multi-step agent
workflow (Tax Snapshot Strategies Memo QC) stays coherent and self-honest end-to-end - results set
model-config and prompt decisions each round.
Pressure-tested the platform against the public TaxCalcBench v2 suite - 1,200+ agent runs (50 cases, federal + 5 states)
through a user-flow simulation harness across frontier models from four providers, permuting extended thinking, web
search, and prompt style with full accuracy, latency, cost, and tool-call telemetry - to locate exactly where and why
accuracy breaks; an LLM analyst judge pipeline distilled the evidence into 7 shipped product improvements targeting
those failure modes.
Built Keystone, Instead's internal benchmark: a 75-case, 7-form golden set (1040/1120S/1065/1120/1041/990/5471 ×
3 complexity tiers × federal/CA/NY), volume-weighted to real filing distribution, with its own eval harness and metric
registry (953 scorecards; strict/lenient scoring; per-tool telemetry across 27 tools). The baseline run located a "complexity
cliff" that now sets the improvement roadmap.
Designed and run Project Evals, Instead's human-expert ground-truth program: scenarios seeded from government
e-file certification test cases (real-world-derived, PII-free) are worked end-to-end by in-house tax analysts simulating a
firm-client engagement (~20 tasks per case: return, tax-saving plan, workbook, memo, client email), with tax-manager
review as the acceptance gate - 2,000 human-authored, reviewed datasets targeted, benchmarking accuracy per task type
and seeding model training.
Built the retrieval foundation the product's answers stand on - and made it self-maintaining: a 270K+-record corpus of
first-party primary law (federal and state statutes, regulations, case law and DoR rulings, plus local tax) spanning 230+
source types across all 51 jurisdictions, fed by a config-driven agentic ingestion pipeline (browser-agent collection
scraping multi-model LLM cleaning and enrichment MongoDB) that re-scrapes sources daily on update, so no one
maintains the corpus by hand. Wrote the pipeline PRDs and schemas, built a Python fetchability harness across 378
sources, and led ~139K-document remediation - because retrieval quality caps answer quality.
Eliminated the product's most dangerous failure mode - plausible-but-wrong citations that read as authoritative - by
attaching document ID and sub-type to every cited source, and gave every strategy a legal backbone: a Legal Support
Matrix across 160+ tax strategies (Tax Court cases, IRS rulings, audit guidance) surfaced through Source Explorer,
command-palette search with cross-type related sources, so practitioners can verify any claim in seconds.
Cut workflow latency ~90% (10–15 min under a minute) by scoping incremental edits to changed inputs only - turning
a batch process into an interactive tool practitioners iterate with - & hardened mid-workflow model-availability handling.
Mapped Instead's e-file coverage against competitors across 6,201 forms in every US jurisdiction (2,540 supported),
giving the filing roadmap a per-jurisdiction gap map.

Global employment platform enabling compliant hiring across 150+ countries

$100K incremental revenue, a 47% efficiency gain from new SOPs, and the PosterElite compliance partnership launched
end-to-end in 21 days.
Product Manager, Keka HR - 3 roles, 2 promotions Dec 2022 – Mar 2025
India's leading HR technology platform; $25M+ ARR CoreHR suite
Built the Background Verification module zero-to-one (Checkr API) to open Keka's first international market: onboarded
28 US enterprise clients and $2.7M MRR, anchoring the company's US expansion.
Shipped 6 SSO integrations (Azure AD / Google Workspace) to remove enterprise adoption blockers - a 27% adoption lift
and $121K upsell; led the Exit Module revamp, cutting offboarding time 28% and lifting CSAT 80%.
Ran GTM enablement at scale - product training and client webinars (4,400+ attendees) generating 500+ upsell requests
and a 30% feature-adoption lift across CoreHR modules - because shipped features only count when clients adopt them.
Business Analyst, Hurix Digital Oct 2021 – Oct 2022
Led agile transformation of LMS development (43% faster delivery); drove 31% growth in customer conversions via a
video-learning rollout.
OPEN-SOURCE PROJECTS
CrossSource - eval harness for citation-level reliability of legal RAG github.com/zoeb-nomi/crosssource
Built to prove eval craft in the open, on a domain where citations carry professional consequences: MIT-licensed and
reproducible - 25 human-authored golden questions over 22 public court opinions; citation precision/recall with a failure
taxonomy, faithfulness, and answer relevance via an LLM judge blind-validated at 100% human agreement (human
labeling also caught a harness bug the judge missed). Citation-discipline prompting lifted precision 0.981 0.994; recall
(0.760) is retrieval-capped, not generation-capped.
